tools.name: webhook_signature_fixture_lab
tools.description: Generates deterministic webhook HMAC-SHA256 fixtures and optionally verifies a supplied signature using a customer-owned TEST secret and payload. It is offline and never delivers HTTP requests or validates a live endpoint. Price: 0.03 USDC per completed bounded job on Base.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "webhook_signature_fixture_lab" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
